big_case.notes: Underlying litigation governs Temporary Protected Status and work authorization for hundreds of thousands of Venezuelan beneficiaries on a fourth trip to the Supreme Court after Mullin v. Doe, 609 U.S. 324 (2026). Event-level significance is materially tempered, however, because 26A714 was a protective stay application triggered by a narrow administrative-stay gap on GVR remand and was voluntarily withdrawn within 24 hours without any Supreme Court order or precedent.
